Marketing Funnel & Conversion Performance Analysis 

📊 Project Overview

An end-to-end Marketing Funnel Analysis project using Python, Pandas, and Power BI to analyze visitor, lead, and customer conversion performance.

The project covers data cleaning, feature engineering, funnel analysis, dashboard development, and business insights.

🎯 Objectives

Clean and prepare marketing funnel data.

Analyze Visitor → Lead → Customer conversion.

Identify funnel drop-offs and conversion trends.

Compare conversion performance across customer segments.

Build an interactive Power BI dashboard.

Generate actionable business insights.

🛠️ Tools & Technologies

Python & Pandas – Data cleaning and feature engineering

Jupyter Notebook – Data preparation

Power BI – Dashboard and visualization

CSV – Dataset storage

📈 Dashboard Highlights

Page 1 – Marketing Funnel & Conversion Performance

Key KPIs:

Total Visitors: 45,211

Total Leads: 34,328

Total Customers: 5,289

Visitor → Lead Conversion: 75.93%

Lead → Customer Conversion: 15.41%

Overall Conversion Rate: 11.70%

The dashboard analyzes:

Customer Funnel & Drop-off

Education

Job Role

Contact Method

Housing Loan

Campaign Performance

Previous Campaign Outcomes

Monthly Trends

Page 2 – Insights & Action Plan

Key findings:

Lead → Customer is the major funnel bottleneck, with an 84.59% drop-off.

Visitor → Lead conversion is 75.93%.

Tertiary education has the highest observed conversion rate at 15.01%.

Contact methods show different conversion performance.

🎯 Recommended Focus

Strengthen lead nurturing and follow-ups.

Improve lead qualification.

Optimize high-performing outreach channels.

Use segment-based targeting.

Improve data quality by reducing unknown categories.

🔄 Project Workflow

Raw Data → Data Cleaning → Feature Engineering → Cleaned Dataset → Power BI Dashboard → Business Insights
